fol.notes: Copies are numbered: the 49 census copies are 1 to 49 (so they are distinct by arithmetic), the Varrowmede copy is the constant varrowmede; whether a copy survives is a belief (uninterpreted). That the Varrowmede copy is not one of the 49 is part of the edit ('found in 2024'). Counting needs a closed world: every surviving copy the model knows of is a census copy or the Varrowmede copy (presupposition, what the count rule rests on). w1 stores the figure 49 (number_known), which the edit does not recompute; w2 stores the counting rule over the list (the Varrowmede copy counted only if it is not a census entry), so the number follows from the list plus the edit.
